title: A shared registry conversation for CFC and RAF1 families

sentences.text: At RASopathies Network, we support families affected by BRAF-related RASopathies; the atlas also links CFC International to these families through CFC syndrome, although your website does not name BRAF.
BRAF and RAF1 share links to excess protein activity and the MAPK cell-signalling pathway, giving us a reason to explore collaboration—not proof that every family's needs are alike.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: Your CITIZEN CFC Syndrome Registry, PATRAS and our developing contact registry offer starting points; their BRAF coverage is inferred by the atlas from syndrome descriptions.
The Clinical, Genetic, and Epidemiologic Study of Children and Adults With RASopathies explicitly lists both BRAF and RAF1.
We propose exploring shared registry experience before assuming that an existing CFC resource can accept RAF1 families.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: Please help verify whether lentigo maligna melanoma, multiple plantar creases and hyperpigmented nevi occur in RAF1-related disorders, and check these features separately for SOS1 and PTPN11.
We should treat missing symptom records as questions, not confirmed differences.
RAF1 changes can increase or impair protein activity, so its broad gain-of-function label needs variant-by-variant checking.
Could we confirm registry eligibility and any changes needed before inviting families?
Let's hold one short registry review with CFC International this month to decide whether offering CITIZEN to RAF1 families is feasible, using the symptom and variant questions above as our checklist.
Which individual gene changes increase activity, impair it or cause loss of function?
Could a variant-level table linking ClinVar records to published laboratory findings help answer that question?
I'd welcome a small collaboration for our CFC community.
Your CITIZEN CFC Syndrome Registry offers a useful starting point.
Could we review whether it could also welcome RAF1 families this month?
Let's check eligibility and biological differences before any invitation.
Thank you for considering this conversation.
[Your name], on behalf of RASopathies Network (RASopathiesNet USA / UK)
